prior_results_seen: U0-U4 and descriptive close-location bins already observed. Exploratory refinement; no independent historical validation claim.
anchors: 65,334 C0 fixed dates/cooldown; do not reanchor to favorable days
economic_reason: Prior own-relative participation plus price run distinguishes a previously bid-up episode from merely volatile chronic decline; an absolute liquidity floor filters inactive issues. Acceleration creates a shock watch, not evidence of a bottom.

entry_methods.immediate: next open after anchor, diagnostic comparator
entry_methods.confirmed: within next 5 sessions first close > previous high AND close > own open AND close-location >=0.75; only next open after confirmation, no retroactive low price

entry_order: maximum signal/confirmation age1 session; skip if next open above decision close by >3%; no late fills or replacement after execution failures
rank: confirmation/decision close-location descending, prior median actual amount descending, symbol; same calendar day at most4, no per-signal10k
budget: daily total10000, four fixed2500 slots, unfilled remains cash; independent daily research cohorts not one rolling account
stops: P5/P10 initial fill based hard stop. TC5/TC8 prior completed session peak close based, T+1 earliest exit; daily OHLC execution scenario, not guaranteed fills. All nonfixed cap60; lower-limit restrictions retained.
cap: Current >=100亿元 from timestamped quote only, NOT applied historically. Historical unavailable ST and cap remain limitations.
latest: All-A historical; latest displayed identity-verified main-board only; strict passing/confirmation-needed/failed-gates separated. Do not fill vacancies.
